description:
Global engine configuration.

Set once at engine start; individual runs may override a subset via
RunOptions.

heal_threshold.description: Minimum similarity score (0-1) for automatic locator acceptance
heal_threshold.title: Heal Threshold

default_timeout_ms.description: Default per-step timeout when Step.timeout_ms is not set
default_timeout_ms.title: Default Timeout Ms

artifacts_dir.description: Root directory for screenshots, DOM snapshots, and traces
artifacts_dir.title: Artifacts Dir

slow_mo_ms.description: Playwright slowMo delay in milliseconds (useful for debugging)
slow_mo_ms.title: Slow Mo Ms

tracing_enabled.description: Capture Playwright traces (.zip) per test; increases disk usage
tracing_enabled.title: Tracing Enabled

max_candidates.description: Maximum live-DOM candidates to evaluate during healing
max_candidates.title: Max Candidates

title: EngineConfig
